description: The CT Cranium DICOM series is already loaded in InVesalius 3. The current view is in standard grayscale. Change the slice view colormap (Lookup Table) to a pseudocolor preset (e.g., 'Hot Metal', 'Rainbow', 'Jet', etc.) to visualize tissue density differences with color. Navigate to an axial slice where cranial anatomy is clearly visible (e.g., middle of the skull). Export the current view as a PNG image to '/home/ga/Documents/pseudocolor_view.png'.
